SELECT SEQ_MEMBER_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, PHONE, ROLE) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{birth}, #{gender}, #{loginId}, #{loginPw}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE NICKNAME = #{nickname}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE PHONE = #{phone}

SELECT MEMBER_ID, GRADE_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, CREATED_AT, PHONE, ROLE, MEMBER_STATUS, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_STR, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR FROM MEMBER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.GRADE_ID, G.GRADE_NAME, TOTAL_AMOUNT, MEMBER_NAME, BIRTH, GENDER, LOGIN_ID, LOGIN_PW, NICKNAME, EMAIL, M.CREATED_AT, PHONE, ROLE, MEMBER_STATUS, P.POINT, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH_STR, TO_CHAR(M.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPONHISTORY H WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = H.MEMBER_ID AND H.TYPE='ISSUE') AS ISSUE FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN MEMBERPOINT P ON M.MEMBER_ID = P.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN GRADE G ON M.GRADE_ID = G.GRADE_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_VALUE, C.COUPON_TEXT, C.CREATED_AT, C.DEADLINE, CH.CHIST_ID, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR, TO_CHAR(C.DEADLINE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DEAD_LINE_STR FROM COUPONHISTORY CH JOIN COUPON C ON CH.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID WHERE CH.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND CH.TYPE='ISSUE' AND C.DEADLINE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY C.DEADLINE ASC

SELECT C.COUPON_ID, C.COUPON_NAME, C.COUPON_VALUE, C.COUPON_TEXT, C.CREATED_AT, C.DEADLINE, CH.CHIST_ID, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATED_AT_STR, TO_CHAR(C.DEADLINE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DEAD_LINE_STR FROM COUPONHISTORY CH JOIN COUPON C ON CH.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID WHERE CH.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND CH.TYPE='ISSUE' AND C.DEADLINE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY C.DEADLINE ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPONHISTORY CH JOIN COUPON C ON CH.COUPON_ID = C.COUPON_ID WHERE CH.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND CH.TYPE='ISSUE' AND C.DEADLINE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT D.DELIVERY_ID, D.COMPANY, D.TRACKING_NO, D.DELIVERY_STATUS, PO.DETAIL_ADDRESS_FIX, PO.ADDRESS_NAME_FIX, PO.ORDER_ID, PO.TOTAL_PRICE, PO.ORDER_STATUS, PO.ORDER_DATE, TO_CHAR(PO.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE_STR, NVL(rep.PRODUCT_NAME, '상품 정보 없음') AS PRODUCT_NAME, NVL(rep.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH, '/uploads/product/') AS PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(rep.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME, '') AS PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME, rep.QTY AS QTY,
NVL(nr.NEXT_OD_ID, rep.OD_ID) AS OD_ID, NVL(rep.PRODUCT_COUNT, 0) AS PRODUCT_COUNT,
CASE WHEN nr.NEXT_OD_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HAS_REVIEW FROM PRODUCTORDER PO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ID = PO.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT od2.ORDER_ID, MIN(od2.OD_ID) AS NEXT_OD_ID FROM ORDERDETAIL od2 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM REVIEW rv WHERE rv.OD_ID = od2.OD_ID) GROUP BY od2.ORDER_ID ) nr ON nr.ORDER_ID = PO.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT od.ORDER_ID, od.OD_ID, p.PRODUCT_NAME, od.QTY, (SELECT pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCTIMAGE pi WHERE pi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS PRODUCT_IMAGE_PATH, (SELECT pi.PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME FROM PRODUCTIMAGE pi WHERE pi.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.PRODUCT_TITLE_IMAGE = 0 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS PRODUCT_IMAGE_SAVE_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY od.ORDER_ID ORDER BY od.OD_ID) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY od.ORDER_ID) AS PRODUCT_COUNT FROM ORDERDETAIL od JOIN OPTIONDETAIL opd ON opd.POP_ID = od.POP_ID JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = opd.PRODUCT_ID ) rep ON rep.ORDER_ID = PO.ORDER_ID AND rep.rn = 1 WHERE PO.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PO.ORDER_STATUS != 'CART'
ORDER BY PO.ORDER_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCTORDER PO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ID = PO.ORDER_ID WHERE PO.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PO.ORDER_STATUS != 'CART'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCTORDER PO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ID = PO.ORDER_ID WHERE PO.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PO.ORDER_STATUS != 'CART' AND (D.DELIVERY_STATUS IS NULL OR D.DELIVERY_STATUS NOT IN ('DELIVERED', 'CANCELED'))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERDETAIL od JOIN PRODUCTORDER po ON po.ORDER_ID = od.ORDER_ID JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.ORDER_ID = po.ORDER_ID WHERE po.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND d.DELIVERY_STATUS = 'DELIVERED'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM REVIEW rv WHERE rv.OD_ID = od.OD_ID)
